title: Figure 1 · Share of weekday boardings by line
summary: Slope chart: the North and Harbour lines lose share between 2015 and 2025 while the Airport line gains and the Loop line is flat.
caption: Invented figures for a city that does not exist. The chart is here to prove that four converging endpoint labels do not collide.

title: Figure 2 · Weekday boardings, 2015 to 2025
summary: Line chart: total weekday boardings fall from 412,000 in 2015 to 284,000 in 2025, with the steepest fall across 2020 and 2021.
caption: Both series are invented. The counter series is the null version of the argument: the same decline without a closure-year break.

title: Figure 3 · Reasons given for riding less
summary: Bar chart: of riders who said they ride less, 41 percent named frequency, 28 percent named fare, 19 percent named the closures and 12 percent named safety.
caption: From the survey the piece declines to lean on. Shown because the argument cites it, not because it can carry the argument.

title: Figure 4 · The closure years
summary: Timeline: four events from the first closure in March 2020 to the reconstruction promised for September 2027.
caption: Dates as announced by the authority. The last entry is the one this piece is betting on.
